subject: general
question: Who said "The Indian railways brought people of diverse cultures together to contribute to India's freedom struggle"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• He is widely regarded as the father of the nation in India and is known for his philosophy of non-violence and civil disobedience.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi played a crucial role in mobilizing Indians from diverse cultural backgrounds to unite for the common goal of independence.
 
• The Indian railways, as an extensive network, facilitated the movement of people across the country, allowing Gandhi to reach and inspire a wide audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways**

 
 
• Indian Railways is one of the largest railway networks in the world, spanning thousands of kilometers and connecting the length and breadth of the country.
 
• Established in 1853, it has played a significant role in the socio-economic development of India.
 
• During the freedom struggle, Indian Railways enabled leaders to travel extensively, mobilize masses, and spread the message of independence.
 
• The railways also facilitated the exchange of ideas and cultures among people from different regions, contributing to a sense of unity and national identity.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**
 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of independent India and a central figure in Indian politics before and after independence.
 
• He was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and played a key role in the freedom movement.
 
 
 
• **John Mathai**
 
 
• John Mathai was an economist who served as India's first Railway Minister and later as the Finance Minister.
 
• He contributed significantly to the development of the Indian railway system post-independence.
 
 
 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose**
 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent freedom fighter known for his militant approach to the independence struggle.
 
• He founded the Indian National Army (INA) and sought assistance from Axis powers to overthrow British rule in India.
